Subject: variant_id=BTK-p.Arg28His gene=BTK accession=Q06187 position=28 reference=R alternate=H

Task: HYPOTHESES. Read the record (evidence E1-E20, gaps G1-G6). Write at least 2 hypothesis records of different mechanism classes (for example: impaired PIP3/IP4 headgroup binding of the PH domain; PH-domain misfolding or destabilisation; altered PH-TH dimerisation or membrane recruitment). Each needs supporting evidence IDs, a refutation criterion and a starting rank. Label each as an agent-generated hypothesis. Then write a handoff.
